java.head: 5a0e948886055eac4cfa85e1e2b826cc4922a603
java.note: Free generator-v1 implementation includes canonical/compatibility syntax, suspend AsyncIterator semantics, deterministic one-pull admission, fresh-yield borrow rejection, and sticky close-cleanup failures. Instance generator methods remain fail-closed.

llvm.note: Native generator frame/continuation lowering is not implemented. Merged #1069 supplies the canonical compiler-owned rejection gate; draft #1073 adds retained compatibility spellings and native CTest fixtures.

wasm.note: Wasm language support is gated by the real LLVM compiler. Merged #142 verifies canonical rejection; draft #144 extends the same real-compiler gate to retained compatibility spellings.

dotnet.note: Native AOT bootstrap rejects generator syntax before CIL emission. Draft #177 makes the full retained compatibility matrix executable evidence.

js.note: Scalar-v1/program-v2 reject generator-v1 until real ESM lowering exists. Draft #82 extends the fail-closed matrix to retained compatibility spellings.

audit_updates.suspend_fixture: g03 corrected: suspend callables expose T directly; suspension is an effect, not Future<T>.
audit_updates.concurrent_pull_policy: Java uses deterministic rejection for overlapping sync/async pulls rather than unbounded queued runtime tasks.
audit_updates.yield_borrow_boundary: Java rejects borrows created by the yield expression itself and borrowed yield* element types.
audit_updates.close_cleanup_failure: Java preserves non-cancellation failures raised during explicit-close cleanup after physical producer exit.
audit_updates.compatibility_fixture: g10 exercises retained legacy declaration spellings and returns 42 on the reference backend.
